name: browser-use
headline: deep research for eCommerce with Claude Code
short_description: Automates deep research on e-commerce platforms using Bright Data's MCP and Claude Code. Benefits market researchers by gathering and analyzing data on products like 3D printers and portable power stations. Connects to Bright Data's MCP for web scraping and data collection.
author: liangdabiao

sections.overview:
This skill automates deep research on e-commerce platforms by leveraging Bright Data's MCP for web scraping and data collection. It performs structured data extraction and analysis across multiple dimensions including market size, competitive landscapes, pricing strategies, and consumer behavior trends. The skill includes pre-built research capabilities for product categories like 3D printers and portable power stations, with support for browser automation and anti-bot protection. Market researchers and competitive analysts use it to gather, validate, and organize market intelligence from e-commerce sources. Data is collected in structured JSON and Markdown formats for downstream analysis and reporting.
Competitive analysis of e-commerce products and pricing strategies
Market sizing and growth trend forecasting for product categories
Brand comparison and market share analysis
Consumer behavior and product feature trend identification
The research focuses on 3D printers available on Amazon, Best Buy, and Newegg. Data was collected using Bright Data's MCP for web scraping and analyzed using Claude Code.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/liangdabiao/Bright-Data-MCP-Claude-Skill-deep-research`
sections.usage:
```
I need to conduct deep research on [PRODUCT] in the [INDUSTRY] market. Use Bright Data's MCP to scrape data from [ECOMMERCE_PLATFORM] and analyze trends, pricing, and competitor information. Focus on [SPECIFIC_DATA_POINTS] like product specifications, customer reviews, and market positioning. Provide insights and recommendations based on the collected data.
```
